title: Educator & Student Passkey In-App Reset (v0.4.35)
message: Enables instant temporary passkey resets for teachers with direct in-app password creation.
changelog:
🔧 WHAT'S NEW IN v0.4.35 (EDUCATOR & STUDENT PASSKEY IN-APP RESET):
• Instant Educator Passkey: Administrators can generate one-time temporary passkeys for teachers directly from the roster—no email verification needed.
• In-App Password Creation: Teachers sign in with their passkey and set their permanent password in-app, retaining all class ownership and enrollments.
• Persistent Passkey Sync: Preserves authenticated credentials preventing invalid credential errors on subsequent logins.
